background_notes.fact: For the supplied unital ring homomorphism F:End_Z(M)→End_K(U), every integer t and f∈End_Z(M) satisfy F(t·f)=red(t)·F(f). For K-linear endomorphisms P,Q and scalars a,b∈K, (a·P)(b·Q)=(ab)·(PQ).

background_notes.justification: For nonnegative t, additivity gives F(t·f)=t·F(f) by finite induction; preservation of negation extends this to integers. In End_K(U), this repeated integer addition equals multiplication by red(t), as seen on each vector. Also P(bQ(u))=bP(Q(u)) by K-linearity, so evaluation gives (aP)(bQ)(u)=ab(PQ)(u). These facts justify the scalar transfers and rearrangements used in S002 and again in S003.
